sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage-Style Filigree Heart Pendant on Chunky Rope Chain
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a bold, romantic statement with our Vintage Filigree Heart Necklace. This stunning piece features an intricately detailed heart pendant suspended on a thick, shimmering rope chain, blending classic charm with modern trend. Perfectly weighted for a premium feel, it's a high-fashion accessory designed to be the centerpiece of any outfit. To preserve its rich golden finish and intricate detailing, we recommend treating it as a special occasion piece—keep it away from moisture and store it in a dry, airtight place after your day of shine.
